boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: No-cost campus and Manchester activities with access confirmed by Saint Anselm College sources.

cards.title: See the Currier with your student ID
cards.subtitle: 150 Ash Street, Manchester
cards.notes: Bring a valid Saint Anselm College ID to the Currier’s guest services desk, then spend time with the galleries at your own pace.
cards.short_summary: Saint Anselm students receive free Currier admission with a valid college ID.
cards.evidence_claim: Geisel Library states that Saint Anselm students, faculty, and staff receive free admission to the Currier Museum of Art with a valid college ID.
cards.access_notes: For current Saint Anselm students, faculty, and staff; present a valid college ID.

cards.title: Use a library pass for the Millyard Museum
cards.subtitle: Manchester Historic Association, Manchester
cards.notes: Ask at Geisel Library’s Circulation Desk about the Manchester Historic Association pass before planning a visit to the Millyard Museum.
cards.short_summary: A Geisel Library pass includes free admission for up to four people per visit.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Anselm’s Museum Passes page says its Manchester Historic Association passes provide free admission for up to four people per visit, including the Millyard Museum.
cards.access_notes: Ask at the Geisel Library Circulation Desk; pass availability and museum hours should be confirmed before going.

cards.title: Browse Manchester history with a library pass
cards.subtitle: Manchester Historic Association, Manchester
cards.notes: Check with Geisel’s Circulation Desk for a Manchester Historic Association pass, then set aside time to explore local-history materials.
cards.short_summary: The library pass covers free admission for a visit to the MHA Research Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Anselm’s Museum Passes page says its Manchester Historic Association passes include free admission for up to four people per visit to the MHA Research Center.
cards.access_notes: Ask at the Geisel Library Circulation Desk; confirm Research Center access before the visit.

cards.title: Join a Campus Dinner Discussion
cards.subtitle: Center for Ethics, Saint Anselm College
cards.notes: Email the Center for Ethics about the next discussion, then come ready to listen and contribute a question or perspective.
cards.short_summary: Student discussions pair a free catered dinner with an informal conversation led by faculty, staff, or monks.
cards.evidence_claim: The Center for Ethics says Campus Dinner Discussions are on-campus talks for the Saint Anselm community where students eat a free catered dinner and discuss ideas with faculty, staff, and monks.
cards.source_title: Programs for Saint Anselm Students | Center for Ethics
cards.access_notes: For the Saint Anselm College community; contact ethics@anselm.edu for upcoming topics.

cards.title: Drop into a commuter event
cards.subtitle: Intercultural Center, Saint Anselm College
cards.notes: Watch campus communications for the semester schedule and use the Intercultural Center as a place to meet other commuter students.
cards.short_summary: Commuter Appreciation Week is part of a free event series for Saint Anselm commuters.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Anselm states that its commuter events, including Commuter Appreciation Week, are free of charge and held in the Intercultural Center.
cards.access_notes: For commuter students; events are held in the Intercultural Center and announced through campus channels.

cards.title: Try Salsa Madness
cards.subtitle: Hispanic Heritage Month, Saint Anselm College
cards.notes: Look for the annual Hispanic Heritage Month schedule, then join the salsa demonstration and Latin dance lesson with classmates.
cards.short_summary: The annual program combines a salsa demonstration, complimentary snacks, and dance instruction.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Anselm describes Salsa Madness as an annual Hispanic Heritage Month event with free salsa and chips and Latin dance lessons.
cards.access_notes: An annual campus event; consult the campus event calendar for the current date and location.

cards.entity_name: Annual Celebration of William Shakespeare’s Birthday
cards.title: Listen in at the Sonnet Marathon
cards.subtitle: Saint Anselm College
cards.notes: Check the spring events calendar, then stop by to hear students, faculty, staff, monks, and guests read Shakespeare’s sonnets aloud.
cards.short_summary: This annual spring celebration invites listeners to the college’s reading of all 154 Shakespeare sonnets.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Anselm’s event listing invites people to attend its annual Sonnet Marathon, featuring readings of Shakespeare’s 154 sonnets and free birthday cake.
cards.access_notes: Annual spring event; verify the current date, location, and participation details through Saint Anselm’s events calendar.

cards.title: Cheer at a regular-season home game
cards.subtitle: Saint Anselm College athletic venues
cards.notes: Bring your current college ID to a ticketed regular-season home contest and check the athletics schedule before heading to the venue.
cards.short_summary: Students with a valid college ID are admitted free to ticketed regular-season athletic events.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Anselm’s student handbook states that students presenting a valid college-issued ID receive free admission to any ticketed regular-season athletic event.
cards.access_notes: For Saint Anselm students with a valid college-issued ID; applies to ticketed regular-season events, so verify the schedule and event status.

cards.title: Attend a Big Thought conversation
cards.subtitle: Gregory J. Grappone Humanities Institute
cards.notes: Choose a topic from the current series and attend in person or by Zoom; use the companion guide if you want context beforehand.
cards.short_summary: The Humanities Institute’s Big Thought programs are free public conversations available in person and online.
cards.evidence_claim: The Gregory J. Grappone Humanities Institute states that all of its programs, including the Big Thought Series, are free and open to the public and may be attended in person or via Zoom.
cards.source_title: Big Thought Series | Saint Anselm College
cards.access_notes: Free and open to the public; current program dates and formats are listed by the Humanities Institute.

cards.entity_name: New Hampshire Institute of Politics Public Events
cards.title: Catch a public NHIOP talk
cards.subtitle: New Hampshire Institute of Politics, Saint Anselm College
cards.notes: Review the Institute’s upcoming speakers, then arrive early for a public talk or discussion at the bottom of Saint Anselm Drive.
cards.short_summary: NHIOP hosts free public events with authors, lecturers, and political figures.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Anselm states that events at the New Hampshire Institute of Politics are free and open to the general public.
cards.source_title: Tickets & Policies | Dana Center for the Performing Arts
cards.access_notes: Free and open to the general public; confirm the event date, location, and any registration instructions before attending.
